rejected.reason: Measured regression: packed stride 12 was 1.98x baseline; wide strides 3-4% slower. Restored the original scanner.

rejected: Per-tap SSAO/blur early-rejection branches slowed the large-target stand; replaced with kernel/row reuse.
Cube per-tap invalid-ray branches slowed LocalShadowResolve; replaced with row tangent reuse.
Per-tap directional nonpositive/zero-weight branches were replaced with base-row reuse and fixed blocker-column unrolling.
Explicit gradient snow-floc sampling changed mip-filtered precipitation pixels; original snowFloc sampling retained.
SnowMorph explicit gradients differed from implicit sampling on the authored 512x512 atlas (max 0.0001399); restored original implicit sampling and replaced both candidates with HDR fast paths.

Pure-snow water-optics branch also changed authored-atlas sampling through compiler scheduling; restored the entire production WeatherLensParticle. Unused procedural RainLens/SnowLens and generic HdrBloom changes were removed from the count after host call-site audit. Replacements target active contact-bloom, exposure, highlight extraction, horizontal bloom and expanded directional PCF.

The contact-bloom shader branch consumed too many SM3 slots in large ASSAO variants. Replaced by the production host selecting the existing neutral clear when both effects are disabled; compiled contact-bloom remains compact.

Specialized rain culls changed one extreme-phase FP32 pixel by 2.9e-5 despite matching the 3072-case production stand. Restored all precipitation bytecode; the ledger separately identifies the already independently changed AO spatial-row weight and cube final-filter row calculations.

FXC flattened initial contact-bloom and bright-extraction early returns into cmp. Final candidates use the host neutral clear and algebraic horizontal bright extraction; specialized rain was subsequently rejected and restored.
